name: Page Speed Insights
description: Real Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP) and Lighthouse scores for any site, via Google's official PageSpeed Insights API -- using your own free Google API key. Tracks history over time, flags regressions against Google's own official thresholds, and exposes an inter-extension check other apps (like SEO Audit Engine) can call automatically as part of a technical SEO pipeline.

tools.name: connect_pagespeed
tools.description: Connect Page Speed Insights by saving your Google API key, after checking it actually works. Get a free key at console.cloud.google.com -> APIs & Services -> enable 'PageSpeed Insights API' -> Credentials -> Create API key.

api_key.description: Google PageSpeed Insights API key to verify and save
api_key.title: Api Key

ScheduleState.description:
A nested value-object inside SettingsState -- a regular BaseModel, not
an sdl.Entity: an sdl.Entity requires id/title on EVERY instantiation
(confirmed by reading the imperal_sdk.sdl.Entity source), which makes no
sense for a settings sub-object with no own identity in lists/panels.
ScheduleState.title: ScheduleState

return_schema.description:
Everything configurable in the app -- one entity for one App settings
screen (UI_INTERFACE_STANDARD.md, rule 3: everything in one place).

THIS is the only sdl.Entity in the whole settings group -- id/title are
passed explicitly in the handler (get_speed_settings), not as a
class-level default, because a shared mutable default instance at the
class level is also a classic pydantic/python shared-mutable-state
trap between calls.
return_schema.title: SettingsState

tools.name: disconnect_pagespeed
tools.description: Disconnect Page Speed Insights: deletes the saved API key. Existing snapshots stay.

tools.name: check_site_speed
tools.description: Run a real Google PageSpeed Insights check for one URL. The run appears in the central history immediately as Running, then becomes Completed or Failed with its scores and fix opportunities.

url.description: Full URL or domain of the page to check
url.title: Url

strategy.description: Analysis strategy: mobile or desktop. Empty -> mobile.
strategy.title: Strategy

categories.description: Lighthouse categories: performance, accessibility, best-practices, seo, pwa
categories.title: Categories

MetricValue.description:
One metric with a number, category (good/needs-improvement/poor) and
source. Regular BaseModel, not sdl.Entity: it only lives nested in a
list inside SpeedSnapshot, it has no own identity in the UI -- same
principle as list[dict] for AuditComparison.fixed/appeared/remains
in SEO Audit Engine.
MetricValue.title: MetricValue

Opportunity.description:
One Lighthouse recommendation with potential time savings.
Also a regular BaseModel -- a nested list element, not a separate SDL
entity (see the explanation on MetricValue).
Opportunity.title: Opportunity

return_schema.description: One speed check snapshot: scores, metrics, opportunities, timestamp.
return_schema.title: SpeedSnapshot

tools.name: list_speed_snapshots
tools.description: List past Page Speed Insights snapshots, optionally filtered by url/strategy.

SnapshotSummary.description:
A compact snapshot card for lists -- without the full metrics body.
Regular BaseModel: lives nested in SnapshotList.items, the list itself
(SnapshotList) is the entity that carries the SDL id/title.
SnapshotSummary.title: SnapshotSummary
